# Kernel contract: card appendix (generated by scripts/gen_appendix.py; do not hand-edit)

Roots (no upstream): artifact.add, control.goal.open_root, data.load, exec.job.sync, module.define, module.wrap. Every maneuver also carries `actor` and runs the three universal rules (`record.resolve` on every ref, `control.task_boundary` on every ref input, `control.goal_drift` on every input), not repeated below. `any` = base.yaml `default_open_in`. Contract version 2.0.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| `record.resolve` | rule | — | ref | — | hash, via_alias | — |
